note: CANDIDATE Open*Hub.io websites drawn from modular components already built/cataloged in this system. PRIVATE-FIRST: each is a private surface now; it opens (public site + open-sourced registry) only when the open_trigger fires (a real competitor comes online OR a planned release), AND only after owner domain/trademark clearance. NONE is public/active here. Governance: discovery!=trust; a hub registers/▸discovers artifacts, it is NOT a truth authority; candidate!=active; benchmark/review/registry output never auto-promotes. Branded-house: a new hub = makeHub(config) + ONE accent + a products.js PORTFOLIO entry (the openharness design bundle) — no new framework.

release_policy.open_when: a credible competitor launches in the hub's lane OR a planned public release milestone — whichever first; recorded per-hub as open_trigger
release_policy.domain_trademark: owner_clearance_required before any public .io site (same gate as the existing gap-three-hub-sites blocker)

candidates.thesis: BIDIRECTIONAL Skill<->Tool conversion + a CERTIFICATION/trust layer: turn MCP/OpenAPI/CLI tools into portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md), and compile Skills into typed/tested/DETERMINISTIC tools — each conversion signed, sandboxed, tested, permission-declared. The wedge is VERIFIED conversion + a trust badge, because skill marketplaces have a real security problem (malicious-skill audits found credential-theft skills).
candidates.registers: skill<->tool conversion packages (SKILL.md + tool.yaml + schemas + evals + security/SBOM/signatures) + certification reports
candidates.modular_component_source: skill_to_tool_promotion_catalog + the Determinism Factory (deterministic-tool standard) + OpenReviewHub (certification/verdict) + the existing OpenSkillToTool.io (skill->tool direction)
candidates.distinct_from: OpenSkillToTool.io = skill->tool ONLY; this adds tool->skill + bidirectional + a CERTIFICATION trust layer. OpenSkillsHub=skills, OpenToolsHub=tools; this is the verified CONVERSION + trust layer between them. Landscape: mcp2skill (MCP->Skill, CLI), SkillSmith (skill->runtime/tool compile, research), SkillClaw (skill evolution upstream), registries (skills-hub.ai/Portkey = discovery not verified-conversion) — verified BIDIRECTIONAL + certification is open whitespace.
candidates.resolution: LOCKED 2026-06-21: MERGE into OpenSkillToTool -> ONE bidirectional conversion hub (skill<->tool) + certification. Do NOT ship a separate reverse hub (conversion is symmetric; a second hub is bloat).
candidates.open_trigger: open as mcp2skill / SkillSmith-style converters mature; differentiator = verified + certified + bidirectional (a trust badge, not 'more skills'). Pairs with OpenSkillToTool.io (could merge into one bidirectional hub).

candidates.thesis: Get CURRENT/fresh context on demand: watch a query/source, detect change, alert + serve the fresh source-handled context. The freshness rail as a standalone product. MVP = a Google-Alert-style watch (query/source -> change detection -> alert).
candidates.registers: context watches + freshness/change signals + current-context responses (with source handles + freshness timestamps)
candidates.modular_component_source: Baltor Anti-Fragility/freshness/CDC + the Fragile Context Atlas + sanctions_feed_live (live official-source fetch) + the fragile_fact_watchtower opportunity
candidates.distinct_from: OpenContextHub = governed context PACKS (point-in-time, what may be served); OpenCurrentContextHub = the CURRENT/changing EDGE (freshness, watches, alerts). GOVERNANCE: current != verified (freshness != correctness); a change-alert is a SIGNAL that triggers re-verification, NEVER auto-truth. Use official feeds/APIs (eCFR/Federal Register/sanctions), no ToS-violating scraping.
candidates.resolution: LOCKED 2026-06-21: FOLD into OpenContextHub as its FRESHNESS dimension (same source-handled artifacts + a watch/changed SIGNAL over them). Not a separate hub. Freshness is a signal that triggers re-verification, NEVER auto-truth (Baltor decides truth).
candidates.open_trigger: open as live-context/freshness competitors emerge; differentiator = GOVERNED freshness (signal->verify, not a raw alert; source handles + provenance).

Owner-proposed 2026-06-09.

candidates.distinct_from: OpenEndpointHub catalogs ENDPOINTS (where a model lives); OpenRoutingHub catalogs POLICY (how to choose/fall-back among them). Teleon's inference gateway is the RUNTIME that consumes these cards; the hub is the open registry of the cards (candidate, never active, never serves keys or truth).
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable model-routing / LLM-gateway-policy registry competitor appears (e.g. an OpenRouter-style preference-spec standard) OR at the inference-gateway public release — whichever first

candidates.thesis: Open, portable registry of authoritative DATA SOURCES across industries/systems: where to find/verify data — public registries (NPI/CMS, state Secretary-of-State incorporation registries, FINRA/SEC, NCEES, state boards), open datasets (data.gov / SAM.gov / USAspending), and websites — each with coverage (industry/entity/field), access tier, cost tier, the tool plane that reaches it, a recorded authority, and jurisdiction. Plural 'Sources' disambiguates from 'open source' (FOSS). Owner-proposed 2026-06-23.

candidates.modular_component_source: src/teleon/sources/source_registry.py + architecture/source_registry.json + the healthcare-specific architecture/provider_directory_sources.json it generalizes
candidates.distinct_from: OpenEndpointHub catalogs model/inference ENDPOINTS; OpenSourcesHub catalogs DATA sources (registries / datasets / sites). OpenLinkingHub is HOW to match data once fetched; OpenSourcesHub is WHERE to fetch it. The hub is the open registry of source pointers (candidate, never active, never serves a data dump or truth).
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable cross-industry source/registry catalog competitor appears OR at the directory-freshness product launch — whichever first

candidates.thesis: Open, portable RULES for detecting + redacting sensitive data (PII / PHI / secrets / faces / voices) across text, structured records, and media. DURABLE negative space: privacy rules do NOT close as models improve, and the volume of AI-handled data only grows. Owner-proposed 2026-06-23.
candidates.registers: RedactionRuleset cards (entity-type detectors, masking/hashing/tokenization policies, retention + jurisdiction rules) + review-tier thresholds — rules and policies only, never a store of the sensitive data itself
candidates.modular_component_source: the do-not-store-PII governance + SecretRef redaction-safe pattern + access_policy PII grants + the directory review-queue (handles sensitive fields) — substrate emerging
candidates.distinct_from: OpenLinkingHub MATCHES entities; OpenRedactionHub SCRUBS sensitive fields before storage/serving. Cross-cuts every vertical (the no-PII rail). Candidate, never active, never serves sensitive data or truth.
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable redaction/PII-policy registry competitor appears OR at a regulated-vertical product launch — whichever first

DURABLE: as AI media/text floods the world, authenticity is worth MORE, not less — the truth-edge of media. Owner-proposed 2026-06-23.

candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable provenance / content-authenticity registry competitor (C2PA-adjacent) appears OR at a media/claims-verification product launch — whichever first

candidates.thesis: Nothing is accepted unchallenged. Every object can be interrogated — 5W1H, first-principles, adversarial 'what would refute this?' — BEFORE it is trusted. Interrogation emits a challenge record (questions + probes + what survived), never a verdict.
candidates.registers: reasoning_strategies (first-principles / 5W1H / analogy) + adversarial + ai_testing probes + the synthesis verify-and-alternatives ladders
candidates.modular_component_source: src/teleon/synthesis/intent_to_dag.py (verify + alternatives ladders) + the reasoning_strategies / adversarial registries
candidates.distinct_from: OpenContradictionHub detects CONFLICTS BETWEEN sources; OpenVerificationHub CONFIRMS an output. Interrogation QUESTIONS a SINGLE object's design/assumptions first — the probe that precedes both. Candidate, never active; a challenge is a signal, never a truth claim.
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable interrogation/red-team-probe registry competitor appears OR at a public reasoning-strategies product launch — whichever first

candidates.thesis: Every architecture can mutate. A running DAG is rewritten by versioned passes (the descent applied to itself: prune intelligence, substitute determinism) under regression-gated rollback. A mutation is a new versioned layer, never a silent in-place patch.
candidates.registers: optimization_pass (the evolving passes) + regression history + economic_opportunity + the tuner/action-ledger rewrite proposals
candidates.modular_component_source: src/teleon/tuning/{tuner,action_ledger}.py + the optimization_pass registry + synthesis_tree backtracking
candidates.distinct_from: OpenOptimizationHub (private bench) holds the optimization METHOD spine; OpenRoutingHub picks WHICH model. Mutation is the live act of REWRITING the running architecture's graph, gated by regression + lossless rollback. Candidate, never active.
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable graph-rewrite/self-optimization registry competitor appears OR at a public optimization-pass product launch — whichever first

candidates.thesis: Distillation is never replacement — and this hub PROVES it. The inverse of distillation: reconstitute the raw/intermediate layer from the compressed one and show answer-critical facts + source handles + held-out items survived. The lossless-distillation clause made executable + auditable.
candidates.registers: RehydrationReport + retention-report + rollback-plan records (the lossless-distillation proofs)
candidates.modular_component_source: src/baltor/distillation/{rehydration,retention_report,rollback}.py
candidates.distinct_from: OpenProvenanceHub holds output LINEAGE (where a fact came from); OpenReconciliationHub MERGES layers. Rehydration RECONSTITUTES a compressed layer to prove nothing was lost — the audit that gates every promotion. Candidate, never active.
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable lossless-distillation/rehydration-proof registry competitor appears OR at a public distillation product launch — whichever first

candidates.thesis: The harnesses themselves evolve. As models shift, the flywheel mutates the evals/harnesses (not just the components) so the lift bar stays honest — every failure triggers diagnosis -> a new versioned harness, GEPA-style. Keeps the two-axis admission from rotting as the frontier moves.
candidates.registers: execution_pattern (learned patterns) + human_heuristic (evolving strategies) + benchmark (multidimensional) + the flywheel queue + durable-gap-harness runs
candidates.modular_component_source: src/teleon/monitoring/flywheel_queue.py + scripts/eval/durable_gap_harness.py + the supervisor ledger / builder-memory
candidates.distinct_from: OpenHarnessHub HOLDS the harnesses (proves behaviour); OpenVerificationHub verifies an output. HarnessEvolution is the META-loop that MUTATES the harnesses/evals themselves as the frontier moves, so 'structural lift' stays measured against today's model. Candidate, never active.
candidates.open_trigger: open as a portable eval-evolution/harness-mutation registry competitor appears OR at a public harness product launch — whichever first
